headline: Cyberattack Forces H-ONE Parts (Thailand) Co., Ltd. to Shut Down Multiple Factories
body: H-ONE Parts (Thailand) Co., Ltd., a leading automotive components supplier, has been hit by a cyberattack that forced the closure of several factories across multiple countries. The attack encrypted parts of the company's infrastructure, bringing production to a standstill at various sites. H-ONE Parts (Thailand) Co., Ltd. has engaged incident response teams to address the situation. The company is working diligently to assess the extent of the damage and restore operations as soon as possible.
